passage:
Copperleaf Bistro
Notice to Customers

Starting June 1, Copperleaf Bistro will be open for lunch on weekends. Weekend lunch will be served from 11:30 A.M. to 2:30 P.M. on Saturdays and Sundays. Our dinner hours will stay the same.

The weekend lunch menu will include soups, salads, and sandwiches, as well as several of our most popular dinner dishes in smaller portions. Head chef Kenji Nakamura created the new dishes using fresh vegetables from farms in the area.

To celebrate, every customer who orders lunch on June 1 or June 2 will receive a free dessert. Reservations are recommended but not required. To book a table, call 555-0167 or visit www.copperleafbistro.com.

questions.content: What is the notice mainly about?
options: The hiring of a new head chef
The opening of a second location
The start of a weekend lunch service
The launch of a food delivery service
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi ý chính. Đoạn 1: 'Starting June 1, Copperleaf Bistro will be open for lunch on weekends' → thông báo về việc bắt đầu phục vụ bữa trưa cuối tuần (C). Bài có nhắc bếp trưởng nhưng không nói mới tuyển (A); không có chi nhánh mới (B) hay giao hàng (D).

questions.content: What will customers who order lunch on June 1 or June 2 receive?
options: A gift card for a later visit
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'every customer who orders lunch on June 1 or June 2 will receive a free dessert' → món tráng miệng miễn phí (A). (B), (C), (D) không được nhắc trong bài.

questions.content: What is suggested about Copperleaf Bistro?
options: It requires reservations for every meal.
It did not serve lunch on weekends before June.
It is planning to change its dinner hours next month.
questions.explanation: Câu suy luận. Đoạn 1 nói 'Starting June 1 … will be open for lunch on weekends' → có thể suy ra trước tháng 6 nhà hàng chưa phục vụ bữa trưa cuối tuần (B). (A) trái với 'Reservations are recommended but not required'; (C) trái với 'Our dinner hours will stay the same'; (D) sai vì rau lấy 'from farms in the area'.
